relations: Heat from the burner transfers through the pot base, sustaining vigorous bubbling in the liquid.
Rising steam above the boiling surface disperses and dissipates into the surrounding air.
As boiling persists, the liquid volume gradually decreases through evaporation at the surface.
Bubbles form at the heated bottom and rise, bursting at the liquid-air interface.
